svg.data-projection: Albers equal-area (3° E; 44°/49° N), local overseas insets
svg.title: French Departments
svg.desc: data.gouv.fr / Etalab, Contours administratifs 2026, derived from IGN Admin Express; 100 m generalization. ODbL 1.0 — https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/. Department selection, Gironde estuary water subtraction using BD TOPAGE, projection, overseas inset placement, coordinate rounding, shared-border topology, SVG and thumbnail conversion. The archived sources and offline generator accompany these derived assets. 101 departments: 96 metropolitan and five overseas. Corsica remains in geographic position. Overseas departments use independent scales in unlabeled insets. No other overseas collectivities are included. Hydrography: IGN / OFB, BD TOPAGE, distributed by Sandre / Eaufrance. Licence Ouverte 2.0 — https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence/
